headline: New NBS Decision on Exchange Offices: One Measure Extended, Here's Until When It Will Apply
summary: The National Bank of Serbia extended until 15 January 2027 a measure letting exchange offices and the postal operator return unused foreign cash bought from banks within 30 days.
why: The National Bank of Serbia is the country's central bank, and its foreign-cash rules affect currency liquidity and the dinar's exchange market.
